introduction.en: India's trade composition has evolved from being a primary commodity exporter to a significant player in engineering goods and IT services.
introduction.hi: India's trade composition has evolved from being a primary commodity exporter to a significant player in engineering goods and IT services.

body.en: The shift towards high-value engineering goods and software services has improved export competitiveness. However, high import dependency on crude oil and electronics continues to strain the Current Account Deficit (CAD).
body.hi: The shift towards high-value engineering goods and software services has improved export competitiveness. However, high import dependency on crude oil and electronics continues to strain the Current Account Deficit (CAD).

conclusion.en: To ensure sustainable growth, India must focus on 'Make in India' to reduce import reliance and further diversify its export basket.
conclusion.hi: To ensure sustainable growth, India must focus on 'Make in India' to reduce import reliance and further diversify its export basket.
